_comment: Project-owned build overlay, merged into every gen by scripts/generate_builds.js.
The gen4-9.json files next to this one are regenerated Smogon exports — anything added
to them is lost on the next sync, so hand-maintained sets live here instead.
Why this file exists: getDraftPool reads csvBuilds keys, so a species with no set in
builds.csv is never drafted. Smogon has no sets for a handful of alternate formes
(they are not competitively distinct), which left their Mega Evolutions unreachable
even though the engine wires them correctly.
mirrorFormes — formes whose base stats, typing, abilities and movepool are IDENTICAL to
their base forme, verified against @pkmn/dex. They inherit the base forme's sets verbatim,
so no balance numbers are invented here. Applied per gen: a forme only inherits in a gen
where the base forme actually has sets.
sets — authored sets for formes with no Smogon presence at all, keyed by gen. Moves are
